items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I might listen to Rob McConnell or Gil Evans or Duke Ellington, people that are jazz oriented writers.

ctx.x: Do you have an opinion about the state of jazz music today?

Not really. Because well I mean I have a few ideas. There are many people that are on the scene that I haven’t heard because I really don’t spend any time paying attention to what’s going on in jazz. If I have an opportunity to listen to something I want to hear somebody write something. Or I might listen to Rob McConnell or Gil Evans or Duke Ellington, people that are jazz oriented writers. But to hear an album featuring another wonderful player? Well okay. Most of the time if it’s really that good I’d like to…
